{{Quote|We can be certain of nothing until contact is re-established with Coruscant. In the meantime we have no choice but to accept the Empire's terms.|Zym to [[Dar'Nala]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]|<ref name="TOC" />}}
'''Zym''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], Zym was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and constructing a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="NGO" /> Gaining a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Zym was appointed [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order sometime before the [[Great Galactic War]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] first attacked the Republic, Zym led the Council in agreeing to fight on behalf of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] against the Sith invaders.<ref name="JMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>

As the war came to a shocking climax with the Empire's request to sign a [[Treaty of Coruscant|treaty]], Zym advised [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Berooken]] to remain on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as the Republic and Jedi diplomats convened [[Alderaan peace conference|peace talks]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. While Zym was off Coruscant, the Sith Empire betrayed the Republic and the Order by [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacking]] the capital world; [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Chancellor and destroying the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. As contact with the Senate was lost, Zym and the diplomats on Alderaan knew nothing of the atrocities suffered by the leaders of the Republic. Establishing contact with Master [[Dar'Nala]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] on Alderaan, Zym recommended that they accept the Sith's term and for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] to apologize to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] for attacking him. When Dar'Nala objected, Zym characterized her relationship with her former Padawan as dangerous.<ref name="TOC" />

[[File:AmRisDarNalaZymHologram-TORThreatOfPeaceAct1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Zym confers with Senator Paran Am-Ris and Master Dar'Nala.]]
After the treaty was signed, Zym sent Dar'Nala and Shan to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to oversee the withdrawal of Republic troops. Dar'Nala believed it was just a ploy to get the two Jedi out of the way. As Zym returned to Coruscant for a meeting with Senator Paran Am-Ris, he was informed that the rebuilding of the Jedi Temple was being held off indefinitely for lack of funds. Zym reported this to a distraught Master [[Orgus Din]], who had lost a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the destruction of the ancient edifice. He then tasked Din to find his other student, [[Fortris Gall]] who was causing problems in the Outer Rim.<ref name="NGO" />

Orgus Din later reported a disturbing matter to Zym; Master Dar'Nala and Satele Shan had been attacked by a Sith warship while they were on a mission. When the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] heard of this, many began screaming for a continuation of the war. When [[Republic trooper]] [[Harron Tavus]] asked for permission to rescue Dar'Nala, Zym said that would be pointless; they had intercepted an Imperial communication saying Dar'Nala had been executed for helping a [[Braden|prisoner]] escape.<ref name="NGO" />

Zym later received a message from someone saying he had information about the attack on the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']], and to meet them at the ruins of the Jedi Temple. When Zym got there, he found [[Gin Lesl]], the captain of the ''Envoy'', but [[Braden]], the prisoner Dar'Nala had helped escape, shot her for getting him wounded on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He then told Zym that he had a message to pass on from Dar'Nala, but Zym tried to arrest him for his shooting the captain. Braden attacked Zym, killing him, and the Grand Master's opportunity of finding out that Darth Baras was behind the attack on the ''Envoy'' was wasted.<ref name="NGO" /> Zym's death caused a power vacuum in the Order that was filled by his successor Satele Shan [[3651 BBY|two years later]].<ref name="JMGD" />
